body.note: The packet proposal is after the w02-p01-024 input; placing it after w02-p01-025 keeps the new chapter after the convention it extends (def:p01-w02-p01-025-equivalence-roles). Either position compiles.

changed_this_pass.body: def:p01-w02b-p01-013-mention (lines 94-109) names the register of app:notation; def:p01-w02b-p01-013-colon-equals (lines 134-236): role (b) extended to witnesses with the restoration instances (lem:q-dichotomy proof, sec:qe-categoricity-02), role (f) names the DPLL listing step of sec:automated-reasoning-01, role (g) names the six restoration-scope grammars, the 'only role (a)' sentence includes the restoration printing; def:p01-w02b-p01-013-role-reading step 1 (lines 248-265) applies the position test inside and outside the restoration scopes, with the definitional sign as the remaining case; def:p01-w02b-p01-013-example items 10-11 (lines 470-482, title now 'Eleven lines'); def:p01-w02b-p01-013-failure sentences on the DPLL step and the witness (lines 509-516), stray word removed; table paragraph (lines 524-551) restates the completeness claim with position as the operand kind for colon-equals and the restoration exceptions; table rows (lines 568-672): restoration definitional row with exceptions, instantiation row + sec:qe-categoricity-02, sec:arithmetic-coding-01, sec:first-incompleteness-04, algorithm-step row + sec:automated-reasoning-01, grammar row + sec:prop-syntax-semantics-01, sec:simple-type-theory-01, sec:normalization-curry-howard-02, sec:modal-temporal-epistemic-02, sec:relevance-linear-02, sec:relevance-linear-03; Sources sentence.
changed_this_pass.intake: rows 224-233: \(C::=\ldots\) for the six restoration grammar sections, \(x:=e\) (algorithm step) for sec:automated-reasoning-01, \(p:=s\) (instance of a stated letter) for sec:qe-categoricity-02, sec:arithmetic-coding-01, sec:first-incompleteness-04. read_rows: no errors; collision_check over symbols.csv plus intake: no collision involving the intake.

patch_requests: work/waves/w02b/patches/w02b-p01-013.json: three glosses (unchanged) and two replace requests on handbook/registry/symbols.csv row 6555; the second now also names the restoration-scope instantiation/witness lines printed by the macro, the literal := algorithm step in sec:automated-reasoning-01 and the ::= productions, all registered by region in this packet's intake.
policy_requests: symbol-scopes.json: add a named scope with regions [{"file": "restoration/inherited-15638-16742.tex"}] (exercise-feedback solutions; only ch:/app: labels exist there) and a row \(\varphi\equiv\psi\) | \equiv | source first-order logical equivalence of formulas | <that scope> | meta | <a declaration label in it> covering lines 334-335 and 994.
The same binding is needed for the unresolvable scopes app:exercise-feedback and app:notation of rows 9 and 12 in symbols-intake-p01-notation-binding-and-comparison-of-formal-w02-p01-025.csv.

The register row \(a\defeq b\) of app:notation (restoration/inherited-15093-15206.tex line 83) is a displayed register entry; a registry row for it needs the same named scope binding for app:notation (LABEL_RE admits no app:/ch: scope).
proposed_decisions: CPL semantic equivalence inside ch:prop-syntax-semantics and its two bound annex files is recorded only by canonical row 129 (scope P2 prop-syntax-semantics); an intake row with the same glyph, role and an overlapping scope is a duplicate glyph-role error of collision_check, so the intake extends the role only to regions outside that scope.

Intake rows \(\tau\equiv\sigma\) (P8 Scott Advice) and \(\Phi\not\equiv\Psi\) (modal tables) restate, with operand kinds, the canonical rows 3596 and 5768 in the same named scopes; their glyph strings differ from the canonical rows, so collision_check does not merge them. The lead may instead fold the operand notes into rows 3596 and 5768 and drop the two intake rows.
Slashed signs are given one convention (def:p01-w02b-p01-013-slashed) rather than a global \(\not\equiv\) row, because a global row would collide with rows 5181 and 5768.

Intake rows reuse the glyph and role of existing rows in disjoint scopes (CPL semantic equivalence, source first-order equivalence, source alpha-equivalence, number congruence, many-one equivalence, judgmental equality, Weihrauch equivalence, rewriting congruence); collision_check over symbols.csv plus this intake reports no collision involving the intake.

Global row \(P\Leftrightarrow Q\) (metalinguistic biconditional between assertions) sits beside global row 30 \(\varphi\Leftrightarrow\psi\); the operand kind separates them (def:p01-w02b-p01-013-statement-iff).
Row \(A\equiv_m B\) (rank) scoped to annex:p3.abstract.3 shares the subscript letter with many-one equivalence; scopes are disjoint and operands are structures, not sets of numbers.

The bare := printings are registered under the glyph \(a:=b\), not \(a\mathrel{:=}b\): the canonical row 6555 has scope global with the same role, so a row with its exact glyph and role in any region would be a duplicate glyph-role error. The lead may instead widen row 6555 (patch request) and drop the 72 \(a:=b\) rows.

Each non-definitional := role has its own glyph string (\(p:=s\) (instance of a stated letter), \(f[a:=b]\), \(E[x:=t]\), \(x:=e\) (command), \(x:=e\) (algorithm step), \(C::=\ldots\)), so regions shared by two roles (for example sec:p09-n-c-017-burch: definition, update, substitution) do not collide; the existing rows \(x[n:=y]\) (P8 Montague) and \(\ \bar a[i{:=}b]\) (sec:p02-w02-p02-008-post) are instances of the update role and are left as they are.
